title: Tails Adventure
subtitle: Tails explores Cocoa Island
summary: Tails Adventure is Aspect's exploration platform game, first released for Game Gear in Japan on 22 September 1995.
body: Tails Adventure is Aspect's exploration platform game, first released for Game Gear in Japan on 22 September 1995. Tails sets out to protect Cocoa Island from the Kukku Army, gathering gadgets and abilities across its interconnected areas. Walking, limited flight and careful investigation give his solo adventure a different pace from Sonic's races. New equipment opens paths in previously visited stages, making the island a place to learn and revisit. The character's interest in machinery becomes central to how the player deals with enemies, narrow spaces and barriers along the route.

Tails can take four tools into a stage, with one equipped at a time. Bombs and hammers deal with enemies, while other devices support exploration. A small remote-controlled robot can scout ahead and enter gaps too narrow for Tails himself. Choosing the loadout therefore matters before setting out, since a missing tool may require leaving the stage and returning with another selection. Discovering a barrier provides useful information even when it cannot yet be crossed, giving the next trip a destination and a reason to change equipment.

Chaos Emeralds extend Tails' flight time, while rings act as health and are lost gradually when he is hurt. These improvements make the growing collection useful to survival as well as access. Twelve non-linear stages and twenty-six items give the island a substantial network of possibilities within the handheld format. Kojiro Mikusa composed the music. The appeal comes from the character's practical inventiveness: a newly found machine can change an earlier problem, allowing a place that seemed exhausted to become the start of another part of the adventure.
story_headings: A familiar place with a new opening
